1. Investment risks Investors who are considering buying BUILDIM real estate solutions should take into account the specific, non-exhaustive risk factors set out below. Such risks may, alone or in combination, adversely affect the revenues and estimates of the profitability of the solution, and lead to a decrease in the value of the units.
2. Dependencies linked to economic developments BUILDIM invests mainly in commercial real estate and corporate properties in Germany and Luxembourg. The solution can also invest in residential property. The solution thus depends on the economic development as well as the general economic framework conditions. For example, a bad economic development may lead to a large number of buildings held by the solution remaining vacant.
3. Limited liquidity and portfolio expansion The real estate market has limited liquidity, particularly for large objects. This phenomenon can have negative effects on price development. There is a risk that sales and / or short-term purchases of large-scale items may not, depending on the market situation, be realized or only through price concessions.

There is a risk that your investment will not be fully exposed to the real estate market because of a lack of opportunity to acquire properties. There is also a risk that you will not be able to sell the assets or that you will be able to sell them at such a discount that the expected return cannot be achieved or that the sale of shares may be limited. This would also have a direct effect on the investment return and the tax value of the fund share at the end of the year.
4. Rate growth Changes in interest rates, especially mortgage rates and inflation and / or inflation expectations, can have a negative effect on the value of real estate, the evolution of rental income and financing costs. However, in accordance with the investment fund contract, the maximum debt weight must not exceed 80% of the market value of all properties.

The Buildim fund

Invest in various types of 'value-add' assets with high potential, in Luxembourg and Germany

Invest in the BUILDIM fund with Sanfreight

01
The fund's investment strategy
BUILDIM aims to invest in real estate projects or properties with high value-added potential that align with the investment strategy.

To achieve its investment objective, BUILDIM seeks to generate medium-term capital growth by capitalizing on investment opportunities in the real estate sectors in Luxembourg and Germany.
02
Targeted asset categories and operations
BUILDIM primarily targets the acquisition of land intended for development into real estate projects in Luxembourg, with a particular focus on value-add assets that offer potential for value creation.

Planned operations also include acquisitions through auctions, inheritance distributions, and arbitrages, as well as the purchase of mortgage claims specifically related to real estate assets.

The asset categories targeted by BUILDIM include office spaces, commercial real estate, residential properties, hotels, and healthcare facilities.
03
